Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the liability of persons rescued from flood waters on roadways.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the liability of persons rescued from floodwaters on roadways; and adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is liable for the cost incurred by the state, localmunicipality, or public agency that rescues that person from floodwaters on a roadway if: (a) The rescue was necessary because the person who was rescuedintentionally ignored warning signs; and (b) By the person obeying warning signs, the need for the rescuewould have been avoided. (2) A person shall not be liable for the costs associated with hisor her rescue if: (a) His or her failure to heed the warning signs was due to anemergency; or (b) Under the circumstances, a reasonable person would have ignored p. 1 SB 6405the warning signs.
